solution: On the highway, a changed lanes across a solid line, and b drove the wrong way, and they happened to crash into each other. The huge noise just happened to wake me from driving fatigued, and I suddenly saw that c ahead seemed to have suddenly stopped because they had missed the exit to get off the highway. It was also my first time driving, and for a moment I did not know how to react, and mistakenly stepped on the accelerator instead of the brake and plowed through.
canonical_facts: The poetic embraces describe vehicle collisions on a highway
A crosses a solid line and B drives in the wrong direction; they collide
The sound wakes the fatigued narrator while driving
C has stopped near a highway exit after missing it
The inexperienced narrator panics, presses the accelerator instead of the brake and crashes into C
